entities.summary: Piotr Gutman is a Polish boxer. He competed in the men's featherweight event at the 1964 Summer Olympics. At the 1964 Summer Olympics, he defeated Pat Fitzsimmons and Masataka Takayama before losing to Anthony Villanueva.
